author: wilson-seok
title: ARM64 Samples smoke test fails with ld.so inconsistency in _dl_close_worker
signature: inconsistency detected by ld.so _dl_close_worker assertion imap->l_type == lt_loaded !imap->l_nodelete_active failed|Flaky Test

failed_jobs.name: Samples / Samples
failed_jobs.symptom: test_model_creation_sample[param3] (Python/CPU) aborted with ld.so assertion failure

key_errors: ERROR    root:samples_common_test_class.py:312 Inconsistency detected by ld.so: dl-close.c: 277: _dl_close_worker: Assertion `imap->l_type == lt_loaded && !imap->l_nodelete_active' failed!
root_cause: The Python sample model_creation_sample.py crashed on ARM64 due to a glibc dynamic linker assertion in _dl_close_worker (dl-close.c:277). This is a known intermittent ARM64 glibc/ld.so race condition when Python's import machinery opens and closes shared libraries with dlopen/dlclose while another thread is active. It is not caused by the PR changes (which touch only a C++ transformation pass and its tests). Only 1 of 206 tests failed, and it passed in other parametrizations of the same test class, confirming this is a transient infrastructure/flaky issue.
reproduction_steps: N/A - intermittent ld.so assertion triggered by ARM64 glibc race condition; not reproducible deterministically
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job - this is a transient flaky failure unrelated to the PR changes
If this occurs frequently, consider filing a glibc/ARM64 issue or pinning to a patched glibc version in the Docker image
prevention_strategies: This class of ld.so assertion failure is a known ARM64 glibc race condition. It cannot be prevented at the test level. Monitor frequency; if recurrence increases, escalate to the CI infra team to investigate glibc version or runner image updates.
historical_context: This ld.so _dl_close_worker assertion failure is a known intermittent failure on ARM64 Linux runners. It is unrelated to the PR being merged.
